## Scope and status

This draft tracks #50 and its linked #16, #39–#43, and #48 in one branch. The [requirement and acceptance ledger](https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/blob/issue-50-653f58325aee/docs/case-studies/issue-50/README.md) lists every linked requirement, solution options, candidate evidence, and remaining gate. Sub-issue closing references are withheld while #48's immutable-release and live acceptance requirements remain open.

## Reproduction and changes

- **#39, first publish:** [release run 36211660562](https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/actions/runs/36211660562) failed three npm publish attempts with `ENEEDAUTH` and logged invalid-bin correction. The CLI bin path is normalized, a publish dry-run regression checks the tarball, and release preflight now reports a missing first-publish bootstrap token instead of treating OIDC as sufficient for a package that does not yet exist. The npm registry still returns `E404`; the owner must supply a scoped bootstrap `NPM_TOKEN` before clean install, tag/Release, and OCI identity can be verified.
- **#40, browser cohort:** The prior `0.12.3` candidate audit had 5/10 complete routes, three challenged, and two semantically incomplete. Challenged and incomplete adapters are explicitly disabled, five supported Nha Trang rental routes replace them, and the generic collector preserves anchor-card detail links, typed availability, room evidence, and explicit location fallbacks. Regressions cover the extraction changes, including Vietnamese no-vacancy wording. Two consecutive *mutable-candidate* runs of the complete 5 VI / 2 EN / 3 RU manifest pass 10/10, with 224 cards and 1,552/1,552 segments accounted in each run; zero cards are incomplete and zero semantic checks are missing. The exact immutable-release repeat remains pending.
- **#41, deploy argv:** A retained real-command experiment passes the Docker label Go-template as one argument under local Node 24.21.0 with the locked and newer `command-stream`. The previously reported local argv failure was not reproduced on this branch. A committed manual handoff probe now samples `/ready` and read-only Bot API `getMe` and reports sanitized outage bounds; its focused tests pass. A credentialed cutover must still establish one poller, no lost/duplicate update, deliberately failed candidate recovery, and both published architecture digests.
- **#42 and #43, Telegram:** Existing bot-only conversation and pending-source checkpoint evidence are preserved. Native mtcute session, independent identity pins, and the authorized private 40-source corpus remain unavailable here. The earlier private projection timed out at 600 seconds. A new aggregate-only phase profiler verifies exported LiNo and separates import/export time: pinned `clink` 0.2.10 took 5,315 ms to import and 4,386 ms to export 1,000 synthetic links. A follow-up synthetic scaling check on the same pinned binary took 2.6 seconds for 500 links, 10.0 seconds for 1,000, and 40.8 seconds for 2,000 across import and export; the approximately quadratic trend and upstream implementation paths are documented in the ledger. This diagnoses the bottleneck but does not establish bounded throughput on the retained corpus or complete-window acceptance.
- **#16 and #48:** Exact-release privacy-safe revalidation and issue closure await all linked manual gates. The public registry still returns `E404`, and GitHub has no tag or Release for this package as of 2026-09-27. #48 is therefore not yet addressed; this PR stays draft until its six linked checklists pass.

## Exact-source release and provenance

The release workflow previously created a version commit and published from the **old** workflow SHA. npm builds its provenance statement from `GITHUB_SHA`, so that sequence could not attest the tested version commit. Automatic and instant versioning now dispatch a fresh `release.yml` run pinned to the new commit. That run checks its SHA and checkout, reruns Node/Bun/Deno quality gates, publishes with provenance, and sends the one published version through Docker and release-identity assembly.

The clean registry smoke test installs with a lockfile, uses `npm audit signatures --json --include-attestations`, and extracts the npm-verified source repository and commit for the exact package version. Release identity rejects a source mismatch against the tested commit, repository, or registry predicate. Tests reproduce mismatched sources, and a real public `@mtcute/node@0.32.2` audit passed. This project package remains unpublished, so its own provenance and immutable identity still require the owner-supplied first-publish token.

## Checks

- `npm test` (Node 24.21.0): 805/805 passed
- `bun test` (Bun 1.4.2): 805/805 passed
- `deno test --frozen --allow-read` (Deno 2.9.6): 716/716 passed
- `npm run test:coverage`: 805/805 passed, 100% source line coverage
- `npm run check` and Actionlint: passed
- Full browser candidate: two consecutive 10/10 passes; sanitized totals are in the ledger. Private checkpoints and raw pages remain outside Git.
- `clink` phase profiler: exact synthetic export verification passed; private-input mode refuses CI and prints aggregate timings only.
- CI on commit [`0f16d12`](https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/commit/0f16d12d89c2bcda23a5bae9ab6d3d7d30e9359f): all five workflows passed ([Checks and release](https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/actions/runs/36303955299), [Workflows](https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/actions/runs/36303955258), [Security](https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/actions/runs/36303955272), [Example app](https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/actions/runs/36303955282), [Broken Link Checker](https://github.com/konard/vietnam-accomodation-search/actions/runs/36303955254)).

## Remaining acceptance inputs

1. npm package owner: configure a scoped first-publish `NPM_TOKEN`, then trusted publishing; verify clean registry install, provenance, exact tag/Release, and accepted OCI/no-OCI identity.
2. Telegram operator: provide a protected native mtcute login and independent bot/runtime-user/driver pins, plus authorized local access to the retained 40-source corpus and `clink` binary. No credentials, numeric identities, aliases, posts, or private traces belong in this PR.
3. Deployment operator: provide an authorized live Bot API window and published image digests to measure handoff, failed-candidate restoration, and cross-architecture checks.
4. Repeat #16 and #40–#43 on one immutable release, commit only privacy-safe aggregates, and add separate closing references for #16, #39–#43, #48, and #50 when every acceptance checklist passes.



Fixes #50
